title: Two Orcas Smashed a 2-Ton Fish Into Thousands of Pieces

scenes.text: Two orcas rammed a giant fish into thousands of pieces.
It was an ocean sunfish, about ten feet long and up to two tons.
Scientists filmed it near Baja California, in Mexico.
One orca held the sunfish steady, often by its tail.
Then a second orca slammed into it at full speed.
The fish burst apart, and the pod fed on the pieces.
Nobody had described it before. Two orcas, one fish, thousands of pieces.

description:
Two orcas rammed a giant fish into thousands of pieces.
Researchers filmed one orca holding an ocean sunfish while another hit it at full speed off Baja California. Only two cases have been recorded, in 2024 and 2025.
Play or dinner: what do you think it was?
first_comment: Bonus: sunfish are among the species orcas hunt most often in that part of Mexico. Was this hunting or playing?
